name: Lethean-Donjon
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
